def proposals(uint256 _param1) payable: 
  require _param1 < proposals.length
  mem[416] = uint256(stor[sha3((10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2)].field_0)
  idx = 416
  s = 0
  while stor[(10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2].length + 416 > idx + 32:
      mem[idx + 32] = uint256(stor[s + sha3((10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2)].field_256)
      idx = idx + 32
      s = s + 1
      continue 
  return address(proposals[_param1].field_0), 
         uint256(proposals[_param1].field_256),
         Array(len=stor[(10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2].length, data=mem[416 len stor[(10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2].length + (floor32(stor[(10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2].length - 1) + -stor[(10 * _param1) + ('name', 'proposals', 4) + 2].length + 32 % 32)]),

         uint8(proposals[_param1].field_1024),
         uint8(proposals[_param1].field_1024),
         uint256(proposals[_param1].field_1280),
         uint256(proposals[_param1].field_1536),
         uint256(proposals[_param1].field_1792)

  uint256(stor0) = newOwner or Mask(96, 160, uint256(stor0))

def _fallback(?) payable: # default function
  if call.value > priceOfAUnicornInFinney:
      call address(stor8.length).mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) with:
           gas gas_remaining - 25050 wei
          args caller, call.value / 10^15 * priceOfAUnicornInFinney
      require ext_call.success

def vote(uint256 proposalNumber, bool supportsProposal, string justificationText) payable: 
  require memberId[caller]
  require memberId[caller] < stor7.length
  require proposalNumber < proposals.length
  require uint8(stor[code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposalNumber) + 9][caller].field_0) != 1
  uint8(stor[code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposalNumber) + 9][caller].field_0) = 1
  uint256(stor[code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposalNumber) + 5].field_0) += storA66C[stor6[caller]]
  if not supportsProposal:
      uint256(stor[code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposalNumber) + 6].field_0) -= storA66C[stor6[caller]]
  else:
      uint256(stor[code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposalNumber) + 6].field_0) += storA66C[stor6[caller]]
  log Voted(
        uint256 proposalID=proposalNumber,
        bool position=supportsProposal,
        address voter=caller,
        string justification=Array(len=justificationText.length, data=justificationText[all]))
  return 0

      if not stor7.length <= stor7.length + 1:

          idx = (5 * stor7.length) + 5
          while sha3(7) + (5 * stor7.length) > idx + sha3(mem[0]):

              uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].field_0) = 0
              uint8(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].field_0) = 0

                      s = s + 1
                      continue 
              uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_0) = 0
              idx = idx + 1
              continue 
      require stor7.length < stor7.length
      uint256(stor7[stor7.length].field_0) = Mask(96, 0, stor7[stor7.length].field_160)
      uint256(stor7[stor7.length].field_256) = voteWeight

def executeProposal(uint256 proposalNumber, bytes transactionBytecode) payable: 
  mem[128 len transactionBytecode.length] = transactionBytecode[all]
  require proposalNumber < proposals.length
  require block.timestamp >= stor8A35[proposalNumber]
  require not uint8(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_0)
  mem[ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 128] = address(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0)
  mem[ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 148] = uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 1].field_0)
  mem[ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 180 len transactionBytecode.length] = transactionBytecode[all]
  require uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 7].field_0) == sha3(address(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0), uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 1].field_0), transactionBytecode[all])
  require uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 5].field_0) >= stor1.length
  if uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 6].field_0) <=′ stor3.length:
      uint8(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_0) = 1
      uint8(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_8) = 0
  else:
      mem[ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 128 len transactionBytecode.length] = transactionBytecode[all]
      if not transactionBytecode.length % 32:
          call address(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0) with:
             value uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 1].field_0) wei
               gas gas_remaining - 34050 wei
              args transactionBytecode[all]
      else:
          mem[floor32(transactionBytecode.length) + ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 128] = mem[floor32(transactionBytecode.length) + ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + -(transactionBytecode.length % 32) + 160 len transactionBytecode.length % 32]
          call address(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0).mem[ceil32(transactionBytecode.length) + 128 len 4] with:

               gas gas_remaining - 34050 wei

  stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_256 % 1 = 0
  log ProposalTallied(
        uint256 proposalID=proposalNumber,
        int256 result=uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 6].field_0),
        uint256 quorum=uint256(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 5].field_0),
        bool active=uint8(stor[(10 * proposalNumber) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_8))
  return 0

def newProposalInEther(address beneficiary, uint256 etherAmount, string jobDescription, bytes transactionBytecode) payable: 
  require memberId[caller]
  require memberId[caller] < stor7.length
  require uint8(stor56A6[stor6[caller]])
  proposals.length++
  if not proposals.length <= proposals.length + 1:
      mem[0] = 4
      idx = (10 * proposals.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 10
      while code.data[6371 len 32] + (10 * proposals.length) > idx:
          address(stor[idx].field_0) = 0
          stor1[idx] = 0
          stor2[idx] = 0
          if 31 < stor[idx + 2].length:
              s = sha3(idx + 2)
              while sha3(idx + 2) + (stor[idx + 2].length + 31 / 32) > s:
                  uint256(stor[s].field_0) = 0
                  s = s + 1
                  continue 
          stor3[idx] = 0
          uint16(proposals[idx].field_0) = 0
          stor5[idx] = 0
          memberId[idx] = 0
          uint256(stor7[idx].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor8[idx]) = 0
          mem[0] = idx + 8
          s = sha3(mem[0])
          while sha3(idx + 8) + (2 * uint256(stor8[idx])) > s:
              Mask(168, 0, stor[s].field_0) = 0
              stor1[s] = 0
              if 31 < stor[s + 1].length:
                  mem[0] = s + 1
                  t = sha3(s + 1)
                  while sha3(s + 1) + (stor[s + 1].length + 31 / 32) > t:
                      uint256(stor[t].field_0) = 0
                      t = t + 1
                      continue 
              s = s + 1
              continue 
          idx = idx + 1
          continue 
  require proposals.length < proposals.length
  uint256(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0) = beneficiary or Mask(96, 160, uint256(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32]].field_0))
  stor8A35[stor4.length] = 10^18 * etherAmount
  uint256(stor[sha3((10 * stor4.length) - 0x75ca53043ea007e5c65182cbb028f60d7179ff4b55739a3949b401801c942e63)][].field_0) = Array(len=jobDescription.length, data=jobDescription[all])
  uint256(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 7].field_0) = sha3(beneficiary, 10^18 * etherAmount, transactionBytecode[all])
  uint256(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 3].field_0) = block.timestamp + (60 * stor2.length)
  uint8(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_0) = 0
  uint8(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 4].field_8) = 0
  uint256(stor[(10 * stor4.length) + code.data[6371 len 32] + 5].field_0) = 0
  log ProposalAdded(
        uint256 proposalID=proposals.length,
        address recipient=address(beneficiary),
        uint256 amount=etherAmount,
        string description=Array(len=jobDescription.length, data=jobDescription[all]))
  stor5.length = proposals.length + 1
  return proposals.length

def newProposalInWei(address beneficiary, uint256 weiAmount, string JobDescription, bytes transactionBytecode) payable: 
  require memberId[caller]
  require memberId[caller] < stor7.length
  require uint8(stor56A6[stor6[caller]])
  proposals.length++
  if not proposals.length <= proposals.length + 1:
      mem[0] = 4
      idx = (10 * proposals.length) + 10
      while sha3(4) + (10 * proposals.length) > idx + sha3(mem[0]):
          address(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0])].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 1].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].field_0) = 0
          if 31 < stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length:
              s = sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2)
              while sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2) + (stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 2].length + 31 / 32) > s:
                  uint256(stor[s].field_0) = 0
                  s = s + 1
                  continue 
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 3].field_0) = 0
          uint16(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 4].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 5].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 6].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 7].field_0) = 0
          uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 8].field_0) = 0
          mem[0] = idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 8
          s = sha3(mem[0])
          while sha3(idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 8) + (2 * uint256(stor[idx + sha3(mem[0]) + 8].field_0)) > s:
              Mask(168, 0, stor[s].field_0) = 0
              stor1[s] = 0
              if 31 < stor[s + 1].length:
                  mem[0] = s + 1
                  t = sha3(s + 1)
                  while sha3(s + 1) + (stor[s + 1].length + 31 / 32) > t:
                      uint256(stor[t].field_0) = 0
                      t = t + 1
                      continue 
              s = s + 1
              continue 
          idx = idx + 1
          continue 
  require proposals.length < proposals.length
  uint256(proposals[proposals.length].field_0) = beneficiary or Mask(96, 160, uint256(proposals[proposals.length].field_0))
  uint256(proposals[proposals.length].field_256) = weiAmount

  uint8(proposals[proposals.length].field_1024) = 0
  uint8(proposals[proposals.length].field_1032) = 0
  uint256(proposals[proposals.length].field_1280) = 0
  log ProposalAdded(
        uint256 proposalID=proposals.length,
        address recipient=address(beneficiary),
        uint256 amount=weiAmount,
        string description=Array(len=JobDescription.length, data=JobDescription[all]))
  stor5.length = proposals.length + 1
  return proposals.length
